title: Wi-Fi access point, local server, and DNS redirection

questions.prompt: Which option states the main idea of “Wi-Fi access point, local server, and DNS redirection” correctly?
options: For first-time setup, a device can create a Wi-Fi network and a local control page that a phone can open without internet.
A device on a local network is not automatically reachable from the internet.
An ESP32 can join a router in STA mode to fetch information from a service or send sensor readings to it.
An ESP32 can use Wi-Fi to join a network or create its own network.
questions.answer: For first-time setup, a device can create a Wi-Fi network and a local control page that a phone can open without internet.
questions.explanation: For first-time setup, a device can create a Wi-Fi network and a local control page that a phone can open without internet.
